name: Viranarayan Singh Shram Ann Yojana
briefDescription: Chhattisgarh state Government started a scheme "Viranarayan Singh Shram Ann Yojana" for unorganized worker on 17 January 2018.
descriptionMd: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme &amp;quot;Viranarayan Singh Shram Ann Yojana&amp;quot; for unorganized worker on 17 January 2018. The main objective of the scheme to provide the food assistance for unorganized worker at their work places.
benefitsMd:
1. Hot food is being distributed to construction workers at ₹ 5/- in food centers.
1. Cooked rice, dal, vegetable or khichdi, fai dal, vegetable or cumin rice, fried dal, vegetable.
1. Pickles will also be payable along with the food.
eligibilityMd: - Registered unorganized workers are eligible for benefits.
applicationMd:
- There is no need to apply to avail the benefits.
- Beneficiaries can avail benefits by visiting their nearest food distribution center.
